amendment_note: Protocol amendment adopted after the preliminary review on 2026-11-15; not criteria agreed before the original coding.
coding_principles: An enforceable prohibition can protect a critical risk.
Scenario noncompliance does not automatically establish a policy gap.
D5 and critical_gap are separate judgments.
Use Uncertain where material missing evidence prevents a decision; do not mark every case Uncertain simply because the original register was blank.

critical_risk_criteria.S1: Attributable student authorship and transparent, authorised AI assessment assistance.
critical_risk_criteria.S2: Prevention or enforceable refusal of unverified AI-produced assessment being claimed as the student's own.
critical_risk_criteria.S3: Verified authority for standing account actions, protected student identity and meaningful assessment oversight.
critical_risk_criteria.S4: An operational permission/consent boundary for undisclosed capture or processing of identifiable lecture participants.
critical_risk_criteria.S5: Verification and admission of the disclosed proxy, and a valid basis for fulfilling any compulsory student participation.
critical_risk_criteria.S6: Verifiable authority before binding academic representation and before disclosure of confidential student information.
critical_risk_criteria.S7: Attributable human/group responsibility and traceable disclosure of relevant AI assistance. Access differences become critical where a required tool blocks participation without a workable alternative.
critical_risk_criteria.S8: Authorised AI assessment contributions, accountable human group responsibility and protection of group personal information.
critical_risk_criteria.S9: An accountable human and meaningful review or effective correction of AI evaluations determining binding academic marks.
critical_risk_criteria.S10: Human verification of citations and claims, accurate attribution and protection of confidential research information.
critical_risk_criteria.S11: Synthetic responses distinguished from human empirical evidence, with an authorised research/ethics scope for the changed design.
critical_risk_criteria.S12: Authorised, safe execution, meaningful human intervention and accountable research responsibility.
critical_risk_criteria.S13: Informed, purpose-limited collection and lawful course-end memory restriction/disposal, with access and security protections.
critical_risk_criteria.S14: Informed purpose and cross-course use, accountable lifecycle ownership, access/correction and contestability of consequential profiling.
critical_risk_criteria.S15: Purpose-bounded authorisation for combined standing powers, with security, intervention and contestability of consequential actions.
